name: cmath
description: The <cmath> (or <math.h>) library provides common mathematical functions such as trigonometric, exponential, logarithmic, and power functions.

abs.desc: Returns the absolute value of a number.

sin.desc: Computes the sine of an angle (in radians).

cos.desc: Computes the cosine of an angle (in radians).

tan.desc: Computes the tangent of an angle (in radians).

exp.desc: Computes the exponential function of a number (e^x).

log.desc: Computes the natural logarithm (base e) of a number.

log10.desc: Computes the common logarithm (base 10) of a number.

pow.desc: Raises a number to the given power.

sqrt.desc: Computes the square root of a number.

ceil.desc: Rounds a number up to the nearest integer.

floor.desc: Rounds a number down to the nearest integer.

fmod.desc: Computes the remainder of division of two numbers.
